claims.quote: "I volunteer to be guarantor—my time and my instructional hours—to underwrite the first set of petitions. Let the record show a guarantor with a name who will be accountable."
claims.value: Rue volunteers as guarantor, pledging instructional hours to underwrite petitions for release

claims.quote: The clerk wrote the heading into the Folio: 'Pending Release — conditional upon sponsor or municipal acknowledgment; civic exchange recorded.' He left a narrow column for names and another for witnesses.
claims.value: Folio contains a new 'Pending Release' column for conditional release based on sponsor/municipal acknowledgment and civic exchange

claims.quote: "We will convene counsel within three days to consider petitions under this entry," she said. "Let the clerks prepare the lists."
claims.value: Headmistress schedules counsel within three days to review petitions under the Pending Release entry

claims.quote: The Envoy inclined his head and, in a small, efficient motion, noted the city's receipt of the civic pledge—an acceptance in principle, not full ratification.
claims.value: Envoy acknowledged the civic pledge in principle; acceptance in principle recorded

claims.quote: "The cost was immediate. The rota boards were adjusted: apprentices would lose hours; ration tickets were cut; cooks doubled their output."
claims.value: Costs include reduced apprenticeship hours, rationed provisions, and increased labor demands
